opening.title: Partnerships and Business Development Lead
opening.summary: Build distribution beyond our own app: B2B and API partnerships, merchant relationships and commercial integrations.
opening.about: Nasfam Pay already runs the rails for crypto purchases, bills and bank withdrawals. Other businesses can use them too. This role finds those businesses, structures deals that work for both sides, and sees them through to live integrations.
owns: The partnership pipeline, from first conversation to signed agreement.
Developer and API partnerships, with engineering on the integration.
Merchant and strategic relationships after they go live.
responsibilities: Identify and qualify partners where our rails create real value.
Negotiate commercial terms with the founder and legal counsel.
Coordinate integrations with engineering and keep partners informed.
Track partner performance and grow the relationships that work.
requirements: A record of originating and closing B2B partnerships, ideally in fintech or payments.
Comfort discussing technical integrations with engineers and partners.
Strong written and spoken communication, and patience with long sales cycles.
niceToHave: An existing network in Nigerian fintech, crypto or e-commerce.
Experience with API products or developer platforms.
success: Within your first quarter there is a qualified pipeline with clear next steps.
Within six months at least one partnership is live and measured.

questions.label: Tell us about a partnership you originated and closed. What made it work for both sides?
